title: SMS Testing Activation Guide
description: Step-by-step guide to enable SMS Testing on your device

steps.title: Select SMS Testing
steps.description: From the Unetwork Tasks screen, tap on 'SMS Testing' to view details and begin the activation process.

steps.title: Review How It Works
steps.description: Read through the process: 1) Opt in to participate, 2) Verify your phone number, 3) Receive test SMS messages, 4) Report whether you received the message and its contents, 5) Earn rewards for each successful test. Then tap 'ACCEPT' to continue.

steps.title: Enter Your Phone Number
steps.description: Select your country code and enter your phone number to receive a verification code via SMS.

steps.title: Verify with OTP
steps.description: Enter the 6-digit verification code sent to your phone and tap 'VERIFY' to complete the setup. Test messages may come from various international numbers.
